response.overview: To speak with someone at Qantas, call ☏ +61-1800-290-956 (AUS) OR +1-888-315-9962 (US) OR +44-800-652-9734 (UK) within Australia for general enquiries (available 7 am–7 pm AEST, Mon–Fri; 8 am–5 pm weekends). For urgent booking issues, international support, or specific needs, use the Qantas contact page to find dedicated numbers, such as ☏ +61-1800-290-956 (AUS) OR +1-888-315-9962 (US) OR +44-800-652-9734 (UK) for the US.
